name: codesync-coderace
description: CodeSync (real-time collaborative editor) and CodeRace (1v1 coding duels) in one web app

scripts.build: npm install && npm install --include=dev --prefix clients/landing && npm install --include=dev --prefix clients/codesync && npm install --include=dev --prefix clients/coderace && npm run build --prefix clients/landing && npm run build --prefix clients/codesync && npm run build --prefix clients/coderace
